title: Unallocated supplementary rows need sponsor source and scope review
remediation: The sponsor assessment authority confirms each displayed identifier and edition against the checked-in ITSP.10.171 source, which marks it not allocated and withdrawn by NIST. Record a source-cited scope decision per identifier, including any replacement objective reference where the authority supplies one. Keep the path open pending the reviewed determination.

milestones.title: Collect a dated sponsor or assessor decision that reconciles each displayed identifier to the authoritative edition and records the scope disposition
